verses.text: Return, O Israel, to the LORD your God, for you have stumbled by your iniquity.

xrefs.text: “Yet even now,” declares the LORD, “return to Me with all your heart, with fasting, weeping, and mourning.”
Come, let us return to the LORD. For He has torn us to pieces, but He will heal us; He has wounded us, but He will bind up our wounds.
But you must return to your God; maintain love and justice, and always wait on your God.

At the command of the king, the couriers went throughout Israel and Judah with letters from the king and his officials, which read: “Children of Israel, return to the LORD, the God of Abraham, Isaac, and Israel, so that He may return to those of you who remain, who have escaped the grasp of the kings of Assyria.
So tell the people that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Return to Me, declares the LORD of Hosts, and I will return to you, says the LORD of Hosts.’

verses.text: Bring your confessions and return to the LORD. Say to Him: “Take away all our iniquity and receive us graciously, that we may present the fruit of our lips.

xrefs.text: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
Through Jesus, therefore, let us continually offer to God a sacrifice of praise, the fruit of lips that confess His name.
Suppose someone says to God, ‘I have endured my punishment; I will offend no more.
Who is a God like You, who pardons iniquity and passes over the transgression of the remnant of His inheritance— who does not retain His anger forever, because He delights in loving devotion?
Why do You not pardon my transgression and take away my iniquity? For soon I will lie down in the dust; You will seek me, but I will be no more.”

verses.text: Assyria will not save us, nor will we ride on horses. We will never again say, ‘Our gods!’ to the work of our own hands. For in You the fatherless find compassion.”

xrefs.text: But You have regarded trouble and grief; You see to repay it by Your hand. The victim entrusts himself to You; You are the helper of the fatherless.
A father of the fatherless and a defender of widows is God in His holy habitation.

Woe to those who go down to Egypt for help, who rely on horses, who trust in their abundance of chariots and in their multitude of horsemen. They do not look to the Holy One of Israel; they do not seek the LORD.
I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
When Ephraim saw his sickness and Judah his wound, then Ephraim turned to Assyria and sent to the great king. But he cannot cure you or heal your wound.

verses.text: I will heal their apostasy; I will freely love them, for My anger has turned away from them.

xrefs.text: I have seen his ways, but I will heal him; I will guide him and restore comfort to him and his mourners,
“Return, O faithless children, and I will heal your faithlessness.” “Here we are. We come to You, for You are the LORD our God.
In that day you will say: “O LORD, I will praise You. Although You were angry with me, Your anger has turned away, and You have comforted me.
But because of His great love for us, God, who is rich in mercy,
The LORD your God is among you; He is mighty to save. He will rejoice over you with gladness; He will quiet you with His love; He will rejoice over you with singing.”

verses.text: I will be like the dew to Israel; he will blossom like the lily and take root like the cedars of Lebanon.

xrefs.text: It will bloom profusely and rejoice with joy and singing. The glory of Lebanon will be given to it, the splendor of Carmel and Sharon. They will see the glory of the LORD, the splendor of our God.
so that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith. Then you, being rooted and grounded in love,
In the days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will bud and blossom and fill the whole world with fruit.
And why do you worry about clothes? Consider how the lilies of the field grow: They do not labor or spin.
My roots will spread out to the waters, and the dew will rest nightly on my branches.

verses.text: His shoots will sprout, and his splendor will be like the olive tree, his fragrance like the cedars of Lebanon.

xrefs.text: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
Your wife will be like a fruitful vine flourishing within your house, your sons like olive shoots sitting around your table.
If the first part of the dough is holy, so is the whole batch; if the root is holy, so are the branches.
I have all I need and more, now that I have received your gifts from Epaphroditus. They are a fragrant offering, an acceptable sacrifice, well-pleasing to God.
The LORD once called you a flourishing olive tree, beautiful with well-formed fruit. But with a mighty roar He will set it on fire, and its branches will be consumed.

verses.text: They will return and dwell in his shade; they will grow grain and blossom like the vine. His renown will be like the wine of Lebanon.

xrefs.text: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. Whoever believes in Me will live, even though he dies.
Like an apple tree among the trees of the forest is my beloved among the young men. I delight to sit in his shade, and his fruit is sweet to my taste.

I will plant it on the mountain heights of Israel so that it will bear branches; it will yield fruit and become a majestic cedar. Birds of every kind will nest under it, taking shelter in the shade of its branches.

“For the seed will be prosperous, the vine will yield its fruit, the ground will yield its produce, and the skies will give their dew. To the remnant of this people I will give all these things as an inheritance.

verses.text: O Ephraim, what have I to do anymore with idols? It is I who answer and watch over him. I am like a flourishing cypress; your fruit comes from Me.

xrefs.text: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do it again.’
Every good and perfect gift is from above, coming down from the Father of the heavenly lights, with whom there is no change or shifting shadow.
For you have spent enough time in the past carrying out the same desires as the Gentiles: living in debauchery, lust, drunkenness, orgies, carousing, and detestable idolatry.
So he got up and went to his father. But while he was still in the distance, his father saw him and was filled with compassion. He ran to his son, embraced him, and kissed him.
For it is God who works in you to will and to act on behalf of His good purpose.

verses.text: Whoever is wise, let him understand these things; whoever is discerning, let him know them. For the ways of the LORD are right, and the righteous walk in them but the rebellious stumble in them.

xrefs.text: The way of the LORD is a refuge to the upright, but destruction awaits those who do evil.
Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
Whoever belongs to God hears the words of God. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.
Many will be purified, made spotless, and refined, but the wicked will continue to act wickedly. None of the wicked will understand, but the wise will understand.
let the wise listen and gain instruction, and the discerning acquire wise counsel
